newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bombscare at Brussels home of Israeli ambassador.
newsitem.headline: Bombscare at Brussels home of Israeli ambassador.

text.p: Police sealed off Brussels' main shopping street and prepared to carry out a controlled explosion on Thursday after finding a suspect suitcase outside the residence of Israel's former ambassador to Belgium.
"There is a bomb alert. We have closed part of Avenue Louise," a police spokesman told Reuters.
A spokeswoman at the Israeli embassy said the suspect suitcase was immediately in front of the residence of Ambassador Victor Harel who retired a month ago and is currently in Israel.
"Our head of security is waiting for the Brussels gendarmes to deal with it," she said.
